abort.configuration_changed: Another session saved configuration changes. Open Reconfigure again to work from the saved mappings.
abort.one_mapping_required: Keep at least one thermostat mapping in this integration entry.

error.confirmation_required: Select the confirmation checkbox to apply this source change or mapping removal.
error.duplicate_ecobee_source: This Ecobee climate belongs to another mapping. Select a different thermostat.
error.duplicate_mapping_name: Choose a different mapping name. Names must be unique, ignoring capitalization.
error.duplicate_optional_source: An optional entity is selected more than once. Use each entity in only one field and one mapping.
error.duplicate_homekit_source: This HomeKit climate belongs to another mapping. Select a different thermostat.
error.homekit_device_required: Choose a HomeKit climate that has a device in the Home Assistant device registry.
error.invalid_ecobee_aqi_source: Choose an air quality index sensor from the mapped Ecobee device. It must have the AQI device class, no unit, and a nonnegative value when available.
error.invalid_ecobee_co2_source: Choose a carbon dioxide sensor from the mapped Ecobee device. It must report the CO2 device class, ppm, and a nonnegative value when available.
error.invalid_ecobee_source: Choose the required entity type from the Ecobee integration. Optional entities must belong to the selected Ecobee thermostat device.
error.invalid_ecobee_voc_source: Choose a volatile organic compounds sensor from the mapped Ecobee device. It must use the VOC device class, micrograms per cubic meter, and a nonnegative value when available.
error.invalid_homekit_controller_source: Choose the required entity type from the HomeKit Device integration. Optional entities must belong to the selected HomeKit thermostat device.
error.invalid_homekit_preset_source: Choose this thermostat's HomeKit Current Mode select. Its options must be supported Home, Sleep, or Away values; configuration and diagnostic controls are not accepted.
error.invalid_homekit_clear_hold_source: Choose this thermostat's HomeKit Clear Hold button. Configuration, diagnostic, and other known incompatible buttons are not accepted; verify the button's purpose in HomeKit Device.
error.invalid_homekit_temperature_source: Choose a HomeKit temperature sensor on the selected thermostat device with a temperature device class, a supported temperature unit, and a numeric value when available.
error.invalid_name: Enter 1 to 64 characters after trimming surrounding spaces.
error.physical_device_identity_unproven: Home Assistant cannot verify this thermostat pairing. The HomeKit device serial number must match the Ecobee device identifier; matching names are not sufficient.
error.physical_device_mismatch: The HomeKit device serial number and Ecobee device identifier do not match. Select the two climates for the same physical thermostat.

user.description: Select the existing HomeKit Device and Ecobee entities for each thermostat you want to use through Ecobee Unified.

data_description.add_another: Keep this mapping and enter another thermostat before saving the integration entry.
data_description.ecobee_aqi_entity: Air quality index from this Ecobee thermostat device. Ecobee Unified displays the source value without calculating its own index.
data_description.ecobee_co2_entity: Carbon dioxide value in ppm from this Ecobee thermostat device. The value retains the source sensor's measurement or estimate semantics.
data_description.ecobee_entity: Required Ecobee climate for vendor details, vendor actions, and supported read fallback. Its device identity must match the HomeKit thermostat.
data_description.ecobee_notify_entity: Notification entity on this Ecobee thermostat device. Enables forwarding a message to its display; delivery is not confirmed by thermostat state.
data_description.ecobee_voc_entity: Volatile organic compounds value in micrograms per cubic meter from this Ecobee thermostat device. The value retains the source sensor's measurement or estimate semantics.
data_description.homekit_clear_hold_entity: Select the actual Clear Hold button on this HomeKit thermostat device to enable Resume program. Verify its purpose yourself; registry checks only reject known incompatible buttons.
data_description.homekit_entity: Required climate from HomeKit Device. Provides the primary live readings, standard thermostat controls, and device association for unified entities.
data_description.homekit_preset_entity: Current Mode select on this HomeKit thermostat device. Enables preset control for its supported Home, Sleep, or Away options.
data_description.homekit_temperature_entity: Temperature sensor on this HomeKit thermostat device. Its reading is preferred only while comparison with the HomeKit climate and recovery checks pass.
data_description.name: A name of 1 to 64 characters for this mapping. It must be unique within the integration, ignoring capitalization.

mapping.description: Pair HomeKit Device and Ecobee climates for the same physical thermostat. Optional entities add only their described readings or actions; leave them empty when not needed. Commands always use their assigned source.
mapping.title: Thermostat mapping

reconfigure.description: Stage additions, edits, and removals, then choose Save mapping changes to apply them together and reload this integration entry.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure thermostat mappings

command_unavailable.message: Ecobee Unified is unloading or has stopped. This command was rejected before dispatch.

ecobee_command_failed.message: The Ecobee action call returned an error. Check the thermostat's current state before deciding whether to send it again.

ecobee_notification_failed.message: The Ecobee notification call returned an error. Message delivery could not be established.

ecobee_notification_unavailable.message: Enter a nonblank message and check that the mapped Ecobee notification entity and notification action are available.

ecobee_writer_unavailable.message: The Ecobee source is not usable for this action. Check its availability, freshness, thermostat identity, required metadata, and action support.

homekit_command_failed.message: The HomeKit action call returned an error. Check the thermostat's current state before deciding whether to send it again.

homekit_writer_unavailable.message: The mapped HomeKit control is unavailable or no longer valid for this action. Ecobee Unified does not send the command through another source.

invalid_fan_runtime.message: Enter a whole number from 0 to 60 minutes in steps of 5 for minimum fan runtime.

invalid_humidity.message: Enter a whole-number humidity within the bounds reported by the HomeKit climate. The source must provide both bounds.

invalid_occupancy_modes.message: Provide a true or false value for Smart Home/Away, Follow Me, or both.

invalid_sensor_selection.message: Select 1 to 32 distinct Ecobee devices from the mapped thermostat's Ecobee integration entry. Provide a comfort profile of 1 to 64 characters, or omit it when the current profile is available.

invalid_temperature.message: Enter a finite numeric temperature within the bounds reported by the HomeKit climate.

invalid_temperature_range.message: Set the low target temperature at or below the high target temperature.

invalid_vacation_name.message: Enter a vacation name of 1 to 12 characters after trimming surrounding spaces.

invalid_vacation_options.message: Use fan mode auto or on, with a whole-number minimum fan runtime from 0 to 60 minutes per hour.

invalid_vacation_period.message: Provide each date together with its time, using YYYY-MM-DD and HH:MM:SS. When both start and end are supplied, the end must be later than the start.

invalid_vacation_temperature.message: Enter finite numeric heating and cooling temperatures for the vacation.

invalid_vacation_temperature_bounds.message: Use vacation temperatures from {minimum} to {maximum} {unit}, matching the Ecobee climate's reported limits.

invalid_vacation_temperature_range.message: Set the vacation heating target at or below the cooling target.

unsupported_command.message: This command is not enabled by the mapped HomeKit climate's current capabilities and required metadata.

unsupported_fan_mode.message: Choose a fan mode currently offered by the mapped HomeKit climate.

unsupported_hvac_mode.message: Choose an HVAC mode currently offered by the mapped HomeKit climate.

unsupported_preset_mode.message: Choose an option currently offered by the mapped HomeKit Current Mode select, and check that the select is available.

mapping_source_missing.description: Check these mapped sources: {source}. An entity, device association, thermostat identity, or supported entity type is missing or invalid. Restore the intended source or use Reconfigure to select a replacement. Ecobee Unified keeps the saved selection and does not choose replacements automatically.
mapping_source_missing.title: Check this thermostat mapping

error.invalid_timing: Enter whole seconds within the displayed limits and step sizes: 300–7200 in steps of 60 for Ecobee freshness, and 300–1800 in steps of 30 for confirmation.

data_description.confirmation_seconds: Wait this long for a matching report after a confirmable action is accepted. Default 1800 seconds; range 300–1800 in steps of 30. Expiry records unconfirmed and does not resend the command.
data_description.ecobee_stale_seconds: Treat Ecobee climate and mapped air-quality data as stale after this report age. Default 1800 seconds; range 300–7200 in steps of 60. Stale data cannot supply reads or climate-based vendor actions.

init.description: Set local freshness and command-observation limits for this integration entry. These settings do not change source polling, expire HomeKit readings by age, select another command source, or retry writes.
init.title: Freshness and command confirmation

abort.configuration_changed: Another session saved timing changes. Open Configure again to work from the saved settings.
